query: A user completed activation yesterday, unsubscribed from product emails last week, and is still in our onboarding automation. Should we keep sending the remaining activation messages?
expected_behavior: Suppresses marketing email after unsubscribe and checks the applicable consent and message-purpose rules before any further email
Stops already-irrelevant onboarding messages after activation rather than continuing a fixed sequence
Separates permitted service messages from promotional lifecycle messages without treating that distinction as a blanket exception
Recommends updating trigger/suppression logic and verifying the user's channel preference before re-entry
